reafir.add: In Wave Link → your mic → Effects, add "ReaFIR (ReaPlugs Edition)" and drag it to the top.
reafir.profile: Stay silent, tick "Automatically build noise profile" for about 3 seconds, then untick it.
reafir.reduce: Drag the whole curve down a little (about 6 dB), then talk and listen. Stop at the first watery or robotic sound; if it never sounds clean, use an AI noise remover instead.
reafir.order: Keep ReaEQ, ReaComp and ReaGate below ReaFIR, in that order.
reafir.wet: After noise removal your voice may get quieter: raise ReaComp Wet by the same amount (the results show how much).

sheet.tryFirst: Try first (AI noise removal): {{list}}. If your voice sounds clean with one of them, skip ReaFIR.
sheet.noiseReductionOptional: {{plugin}} (noise reduction, optional: only if the AI option does not sound clean)
